id: title:dmarchuk:reject a wait that reads a group property

review.posthog_relevance: Adds runtime rejection of HogQL wait conditions depending on group properties, preventing execution without an event and avoiding potential infinite or maximum-wait-time execution.
review.reason: The change introduces a new HogQL function `find_group_field` and its associated rejection path. This prevents HogQL queries from advancing wait conditions that rely on group properties without an actual event, addressing a potential execution hang or timeout. This is a substantive correctness and reliability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The exact production impact and frequency of this specific wait condition are not established by the code alone; this is a preventative capability rather than a reactive incident fix.
